title: ARCANE
description: A post-game and mid-game expansion designed to give players new goals and challenges.
body:
The Arcane Project was created to add something more during the mid-game so that there is no rush to go to the End and finish the game and for those who have finished the game so that they can be rewarded for each time they defeat the Ender Dragon and improve the exploration of the End, and in the future the other dimensions, the project also aims to improve PvP and PvE with equipment, items, blocks and effects, in addition to bringing new mobs.
open to constructive criticism.
